_provenance: Shape observed live 2026-09-16 against GET /rest/api/3/attachment/{id} on a Jira Cloud test site. Confirmed: unlike the embedded fields.attachment[] form, this endpoint returns `id` as a JSON integer, not a string. `content` is a same-site, authenticated URL that responds 303 to a short-lived signed download URL (observed host api.media.atlassian.com) before the actual 200 with the file bytes; a client must follow redirects to download. All tenant, account, and content values below are synthesized.
